name: TinyURL
tagline: Classic URL shortener with a modern developer API for create/update/analytics.
description: TinyURL provides a developer API for creating, updating, and analyzing shortened URLs. It offers a free tier with limits and paid plans for higher usage. The API supports JSON responses and is designed for integration into applications requiring URL shortening services.

auth.details: API key via Authorization header, self-serve signup

example.request: curl -X POST https://api.tinyurl.com/create -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"url": "https://example.com", "domain": "tinyurl.com"}'

use_cases: get analytics for a short URL
